content.text:
I removed two stray `
` tags from `site/orders.html`, but I'm not certain that was the problem you saw. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't tell what "the last change" was. On desktop and at 390px wide, the orders page looked normal apart from an oversized gap between the stat cards and "Recent orders". The `
` tags caused that gap, and no other page has them. The section's own padding already provides the spacing, so removing the tags should make the gap match the other pages. I didn't take a new screenshot after the edit. All 16 functional tests pass. On a phone the orders table scrolls sideways, so the Status, Total and View columns are cut off. That comes from the table's `overflow-x: auto` rule, which looks intentional, so I left it alone. If you meant something else, such as the table layout, the order dialog or the stats, tell me what looks wrong and I'll look again. STATUS: DONE
